verdict.rationale: GitHub Projects documents manual project status updates with an 'On track'/'At risk' status and a Markdown message. Nothing in the evidence shows AI drafting such an update from recent activity. Copilot issue delegation, the API, and the MCP server are a separate feature and developer building blocks, not this capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have AI draft a project or initiative status update from recent activity
